trials.claim: Previous AppSumo customers grandfathered into new feature limits on Ethos Standard
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into the new feature limits
trials.reasoning: Two buyers report the lifetime code gave only a yearly plan and required paying again, which conflicts with previous AppSumo customers being grandfathered into the new Ethos Standard limits.

exhibits.quote: Clearly marketed "lifetime" deal on AppSumo turns out to be only a "yearly" plan after applying the code in the system (picture proof kept).
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports lifetime code resulted in only a yearly plan, contradicting the promise of grandfathered lifetime limits.

exhibits.quote: This is not a lifetime deal. You need to pay again after buying this deal. Misleading and scammie.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports having to pay again despite buying lifetime deal, undermining the grandfathering claim.
